title: Central Bank Digital Currency and Monetary Architecture
title_zh: 中央银行数字货币与货币架构
title_primary: 中央银行数字货币与货币架构
title_secondary: Central Bank Digital Currency and Monetary Architecture
official: 来源期次 Journal of Economic Literature · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We provide a guide to the macroeconomic literature on retail central bank digital currency (CBDC), organizing the discussion around a CBDC-irrelevance result. We identify both fundamental and policy-related sources of relevance, or departures from neutrality. Bank disintermediation—the crowding out of deposits—does not, by itself, constitute such a source. We argue that the literature has primarily focused on policy-related sources of non-neutrality, often without making this focus explicit. From a macroeconomic perspective, CBDC is, at its core, a matter of monetary architecture, and political economy considerations are central to understanding CBDC policy design.
abstract_zh: 本文围绕零售型央行数字货币（CBDC）的宏观经济文献提供指南，并以CBDC无关性结论为核心组织讨论。我们识别了相关性的根本来源与政策相关来源，即对中性状态的偏离。银行去中介化——存款被挤出——本身并不构成此类来源。我们认为，现有文献主要聚焦于非中性的政策相关来源，但往往未明确这一侧重点。从宏观经济视角看，CBDC本质上属于货币架构问题，而政治经济学考量对于理解CBDC政策设计至关重要。

title: DP774 The Political Economy of the Exchange Rate Mechanism
title_zh: 汇率机制的政治经济学
title_primary: 汇率机制的政治经济学
title_secondary: DP774 The Political Economy of the Exchange Rate Mechanism
official: 官方在线 1993-03-31 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper explains this phenomenon in terms of a `peso problem' of credibility created by the response of a member government to the incentives it faces within the ERM.A country within the ERM that attempts to restrain inflation and avoid economic distortions faces strong pressure from its domestic manufacturing lobby. In the event that trading conditions for manufacturers worsen drastically, they will apply intense pressure not only for subsidy protection but also for a devaluation. When times are good, however, the pressure will be relaxed. This creates an asymmetry in the government's policy reaction: devaluation and subsidy in bad times, and no parity change or subsidy in good times. The result is an average expectation of devaluation in excess of what normally occurs which leads to overvaluation in normal times.
abstract_zh: 本文从“比索问题”的视角解释这一现象，该问题源于成员国政府在欧洲汇率机制（ERM）内所面临的激励所引发的可信度危机。在ERM中，试图抑制通胀并避免经济扭曲的成员国，会面临来自国内制造业游说集团的强大压力。当制造业贸易条件急剧恶化时，这些集团不仅会强烈要求补贴保护，还会施压要求货币贬值。然而，在经济形势良好时，这种压力会有所缓解。这导致政府政策反应出现不对称性：经济低迷时期采取贬值和补贴措施，而经济繁荣时期则维持汇率不变且不提供补贴。其结果是，市场对贬值的平均预期高于实际发生频率，从而在正常时期造成汇率高估。

title: No-Poach Agreements
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study no-poach cartels using a wage-posting model that puts worker poaching at the center of labor market competition. Even when just two out of ten employers in a local labor market collude, wages fall by almost 5% market-wide. The reason is that no-poach agreements suppress competition along the job ladder, with spillovers to non-colluding firms. We then compare no-poach agreements to two other forms of anti-competitive conduct in the labor market: noncompete agreements and wage fixing. No-poach agreements have by far the largest negative wage effects.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一个将员工挖角置于劳动力市场竞争核心的工资报价模型来研究不挖角卡特尔。即使当地劳动力市场中十家雇主中仅有两家合谋，整个市场的工资也会下降近5%。原因在于，不挖角协议抑制了职业阶梯上的竞争，并对非合谋企业产生溢出效应。随后，我们将不挖角协议与劳动力市场中另外两种反竞争行为——竞业限制协议和固定工资协议——进行比较。不挖角协议对工资的负面效应远大于其他两种行为。

title: Balancing Acts
abstract: When exactly does a preference ordering on acts have an additive state-dependent utility representation per indifference curve? Following the analogy of a sliding balance, a perfect reflection of the well-known betweenness models for lotteries, we find three answers for monetary acts on a finite state space. In the first two, we exploit the axiom of weak decomposability, identified by Grant, Kajii, and Polak (2000) as the key axiom to extend betweenness to acts, but leaving the continuity and monotonicity of state utility in setpoints an open issue. Our first theorem confirms the necessity of continuity, while the second shows that monotonicty in setpoints requires the additional axiom of ratio monotonicity . It formalises the idea that sliding a setpoint towards a gain decreases its momentum compared to losses. This observation, in turn, suggests to extend the primitive of a preference ordering with a benchmark for discerning gains from losses within an act. Thus we arrive at the Additive Sliding Balance Utility model for orderings anchored to such a benchmark. In the third theorem, we characterise this class with an even more straightforward betweenness axiom: the balance point of an act should be in between those of its parts.
abstract_zh: 在何种精确条件下，行动上的偏好序能够为每条无差异曲线提供加性状态依赖效用表示？遵循滑动平衡的类比——这一概念完美反映了彩票理论中著名的中间性模型——我们针对有限状态空间上的货币行动给出了三种解答。前两种解答中，我们运用了格兰特、梶井与波拉克（2000）所识别的弱可分解性公理，该公理被视为将中间性扩展至行动的关键，但状态效用关于设定点的连续性与单调性仍为开放问题。第一定理证实了连续性的必要性，而第二定理表明设定点单调性需要额外引入比率单调性公理。该公理形式化了如下思想：将设定点向收益方向滑动会降低其相对于损失的动量。这一观察进而提示，应在偏好序的原始概念中引入一个基准，用以区分行动内部的收益与损失。由此，我们提出了针对锚定此类基准的序关系的加性滑动平衡效用模型。在第三定理中，我们通过一个更为直接的中间性公理刻画了该模型类别：行动的平衡点应介于其各组成部分的平衡点之间。

title: Income Gradients in Health-State Dependence
title_zh: 健康状态依赖中的收入梯度
title_primary: 健康状态依赖中的收入梯度
authors: De Donder, Philippe, Lefèvre, François, Leroux, Marie-Louise, Roquebert, Quitterie
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper investigates how marginal utility varies with health status (e.g. health-state dependence) while allowing this relationship to differ across income levels. Building on the existing literature, we develop a framework that quantifies the income adjustments necessary to maintain individuals’ wellbeing when they become disabled. Using SHARE data, we empirically estimate how health affects the marginal utility of consumption across the income distribution for older adults in Europe. Our results show that health-state dependence is negative among low-income individuals, indicating that their marginal utility of consumption declines when their health worsens. In contrast, at the very top of the income distribution, health-state dependence is positive, implying that marginal utility of consumption rises as health deteriorates.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了边际效用如何随健康状况变化（即健康状态依赖性），并允许这种关系在不同收入水平上存在差异。在现有文献基础上，我们构建了一个框架，用以量化个体在残疾时维持其福祉所需的收入调整。利用SHARE数据，我们实证估计了健康如何影响欧洲老年人消费边际效用的收入分布差异。研究结果表明，低收入群体的健康状态依赖性为负，即其健康状况恶化时消费边际效用下降。相反，在收入分布顶端，健康状态依赖性为正，意味着健康状况恶化时消费边际效用上升。

title: A Bibliometric Exploration of Tourist Satisfaction and Quality
title_zh: 旅游满意度与质量的文献计量探索
title_primary: 旅游满意度与质量的文献计量探索
title_secondary: A Bibliometric Exploration of Tourist Satisfaction and Quality
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The bibliometric analysis delves into the progression and influence of research concerning the quality of tourism, emphasizing the patterns, inputs, and thematic advancements within the domain. According to the study, conference papers provide a lesser percentage of insightful material than journal articles, which indicates a strong emphasis on peer-reviewed research and accounts for the majority of relevant literature. Since 1983, the field of study has changed dramatically. Notable growth began in the late 1990s and peaked in the most recent years, indicating a rise in scholarly interest in high-quality tourism. Important journals like "The Journal of Quality Assurance in Hospitality and Tourism," "Sustainability Switzerland," and "Tourism Management," are crucial in influencing the conversation. Keywords that stand out are "quality of life," "tourism," and "sustainability," with an emphasis on global viewpoints, particularly as they relate to China. The field has advanced thanks to significant contributions from people like Carneiro, Eusébio, and Uysal as well as organizations like Universidade Q9 and the Hong Kong Polytechnic University. Strong international cooperation is highlighted by the citation network, which shows strong connections between China, the United States, the United Kingdom, Spain, and Portugal. The study emphasizes a multidisciplinary strategy that integrates environmental and managerial factors into the quality of tourism. Although the study offers a thorough overview, its limitations include methodological issues, temporal and linguistic biases, and dependence on particular data sources. All things considered, the analysis presents a vibrant and cooperative field characterized by significant scholarly involvement and an increasing focus on sustainability and interdisciplinary research.
abstract_zh: 文献计量分析深入探讨了旅游质量研究的进展与影响力，重点关注该领域的模式、投入及主题演进。研究表明，会议论文提供的洞察性材料占比低于期刊论文，这表明同行评审研究受到高度重视，并构成了相关文献的主体。自1983年以来，该研究领域发生了显著变化。显著增长始于20世纪90年代末，并在最近几年达到顶峰，反映出学术界对高质量旅游的兴趣日益浓厚。《酒店与旅游质量保证期刊》、《瑞士可持续发展》和《旅游管理》等重要期刊在引导学术讨论中发挥了关键作用。突出的关键词包括“生活质量”、“旅游”和“可持续性”，尤其关注全球视角，特别是与中国相关的研究。Carneiro、Eusébio和Uysal等学者以及Universidade Q9和香港理工大学等机构为该领域的进步做出了重要贡献。引文网络凸显了强大的国际合作，显示中国、美国、英国、西班牙和葡萄牙之间存在紧密联系。研究强调了一种跨学科策略，将环境和管理因素融入旅游质量中。尽管该研究提供了全面的概述，但其局限性包括方法论问题、时间与语言偏差，以及对特定数据源的依赖。总体而言，该分析呈现了一个充满活力且协作性强的领域，其特点是显著的学术参与度，以及对可持续性和跨学科研究的日益关注。

title:
Trade Effects of
                    EU
                    Sanctions Against Russia: Evidence From the Visegrad Group
title_zh: 欧盟对俄制裁的贸易效应：来自维谢格拉德集团的证据
title_primary: 欧盟对俄制裁的贸易效应：来自维谢格拉德集团的证据
title_secondary:
Trade Effects of
                    EU
                    Sanctions Against Russia: Evidence From the Visegrad Group
authors: Agnieszka Głodowska, Agnieszka Hajdukiewicz, Bożena Pera, Csaba Weiner
abstract: This article examines the impact of the European Union's post‐March 2014 and post‐February 2022 sanctions episodes against Russia on trade between Russia and the Visegrad countries (Czechia, Hungary, Poland and Slovakia) over 2013–2024. Changes are analysed at both the aggregate level and—based on an original identification of EU sanction coverage—across selected sanctioned product chapters and non‐sanctioned reference groups. The empirical framework combines descriptive statistics on the distribution of the selected product groups with two complementary econometric approaches: a gravity‐based Poisson pseudo‐maximum likelihood model (PPML) with fixed effects, estimated in a difference‐in‐differences design relative to control markets, and a PPML interrupted time‐series model used as a robustness check to identify structural breaks and post‐intervention trends. Empirically, the effects of EU sanctions on Visegrad exports to Russia were strongly negative already under the post‐March 2014 sanctions regime, particularly for highly sanctioned manufactured product groups such as machinery and electrical equipment, and intensified further following the substantial expansion of sanctions after February 2022. Import effects were initially weaker but intensified markedly from 2022 onward, most notably for energy sources. The findings point to episode‐specific trade responses, pronounced heterogeneity across product groups, and a clear asymmetry between export and import adjustments.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2013—2024年间，欧盟在2014年3月后及2022年2月后对俄罗斯实施的两轮制裁对俄罗斯与维谢格拉德国家（捷克、匈牙利、波兰和斯洛伐克）之间贸易的影响。分析涵盖总体层面，并基于对欧盟制裁覆盖范围的原创识别，在选定的受制裁产品章节和未受制裁参考组之间展开。实证框架结合了所选产品组分布的描述性统计与两种互补的计量经济学方法：一是基于引力模型的泊松伪最大似然估计（PPML）固定效应模型，采用双重差分设计相对于对照市场进行估计；二是作为稳健性检验的PPML中断时间序列模型，用于识别结构断点和干预后趋势。实证结果显示，早在2014年3月后的制裁体制下，欧盟制裁对维谢格拉德国家向俄罗斯的出口已产生强烈负面影响，尤其对机械和电气设备等受高度制裁的制成品组影响显著，并在2022年2月后制裁大幅扩展后进一步加剧。进口影响最初较弱，但从2022年起显著增强，最突出的是能源类产品。研究结果揭示了针对不同制裁事件的贸易反应差异、产品组间的显著异质性，以及出口与进口调整之间的明显不对称性。

title: Uncertainty and the term structure of interest rates
title_zh: 不确定性与利率期限结构
title_primary: 不确定性与利率期限结构
title_secondary: Uncertainty and the term structure of interest rates
authors: Jamie L. Cross, Aubrey Poon, Dan Zhu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We document a new stylized fact linking uncertainty to the term structure of interest rates: unanticipated increases in uncertainty generate a yield curve that is lower, steeper, and less curved. Using a Yields-Macro Dynamic Nelson–Siegel model applied to U.S. Treasury yields, uncertainty measures, and macroeconomic aggregates, we show that this result is robust across financial, macroeconomic, and policy-related sources of uncertainty. A stylized asset-pricing model provides a structural interpretation, tracing these effects to precautionary motives under investor prudence. Counterfactual analyses show that uncertainty lowers the expected path of short rates while raising term premia, consistent with precautionary and risk-compensation mechanisms. We also develop an efficient Bayesian algorithm for estimating Yields-Macro Dynamic Nelson–Siegel models with constant or time-varying exponential decay parameters.

title: A Loan You Can’t Refuse: Credit Rationing and Organized Crime Infiltration of Distressed Firms
title_zh: 无法拒绝的贷款：信贷配给与困境企业中有组织犯罪的渗透
title_primary: 无法拒绝的贷款：信贷配给与困境企业中有组织犯罪的渗透
title_secondary: A Loan You Can’t Refuse: Credit Rationing and Organized Crime Infiltration of Distressed Firms
authors: Gianmarco Daniele, Marco De Simoni, Domenico J. Marchetti, Giovanna Marcolongo, Paolo Pinotti
official: 官方在线 2025-10-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We show that credit constraints significantly increase the risk that firms are infiltrated by organized crime, defined as the covert involvement of criminal organizations in corporate decision-making. Using confidential data on criminal investigations, credit ratings, and loan histories for the universe of Italian firms, we find that a downgrade to substandard credit status reduces credit availability by 30% over five years and increases the probability of infiltration by 5%, relative to comparable firms. A local randomization design comparing firms just above and below the downgrade threshold confirms this result. The effect is pervasive across sectors and regions, but particularly strong in real estate, where the probability of infiltration rises by 10% following a downgrade. Infiltrated firms also display higher survival rates than other downgraded firms, despite similar declines in employment and revenues. These findings suggest that organized crime can serve as a financial backstop — sustaining non-viable businesses and potentially redirecting their strategies to serve criminal interests.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，信贷约束显著增加了企业被有组织犯罪渗透的风险——即犯罪组织秘密介入企业决策。基于意大利全体企业的刑事调查、信用评级及贷款历史机密数据，我们发现：相较于可比企业，信用评级降至次级标准的企业五年内信贷可得性下降30%，被渗透概率上升5%。采用降级阈值附近企业的局部随机化设计验证了这一结果。该效应普遍存在于各行业与地区，但在房地产领域尤为显著——降级后该行业企业被渗透概率上升10%。尽管被渗透企业与其它降级企业同样面临就业与收入下滑，但其存活率更高。这些发现表明，有组织犯罪可充当财务后盾——维持无生存能力的企业运营，并可能引导其战略转向服务于犯罪利益。

title: Behavioral responses to inheritance taxes: Evidence from Brazil
title_zh: 遗产税的行为反应：来自巴西的证据
title_primary: 遗产税的行为反应：来自巴西的证据
title_secondary: Behavioral responses to inheritance taxes: Evidence from Brazil
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2024-01-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I examine behavioral responses to inheritance and gift taxes in a setting where individuals knew the tax would increase three months before the new tax code took effect. Using tax microdata from Brazil, I employ bunching and difference-in-differences (DD) methods and find that individuals significantly retime their wealth transfers to avoid taxes. Retimed gifts resulted in smaller inheritances for nearly three years. Moreover, I find that responses are sensitive to changes in top gift marginal tax rates and tax design (flat rates vs progressive brackets). Finally, evasion increased in the medium run in reform states, particularly among small inheritances.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了在个人知晓遗产税与赠与税将在三个月后上调的背景下，其行为反应。利用巴西的税收微观数据，采用聚束分析与双重差分法，发现个人显著调整财富转移时间以规避税负。调整后的赠与行为导致近三年内遗产规模缩小。此外，研究显示，行为反应对最高赠与边际税率变动及税制设计（统一税率与累进税率）具有敏感性。最后，改革州的中期逃税行为有所增加，尤以小额遗产为甚。

title: Can ChatGPT forecast stock price movements? Return predictability and large language models
title_zh: ChatGPT能否预测股价变动？收益可预测性与大型语言模型
title_primary: ChatGPT能否预测股价变动？收益可预测性与大型语言模型
title_secondary: Can ChatGPT forecast stock price movements? Return predictability and large language models
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2023-01-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We document the capability of large language models (LLMs) like ChatGPT to predict stock market reactions from news headlines without direct financial training. Using post-knowledge-cutoff headlines, GPT-4 captures initial market responses, achieving approximately 90% portfolio-day hit rates for the non-tradable initial reaction. GPT-4 scores also significantly predict the subsequent drift, especially for small stocks and negative news. Forecasting ability generally increases with model size, suggesting that financial reasoning is an emerging capacity of complex LLMs. Strategy returns decline as LLM adoption rises, consistent with improved price efficiency. To rationalize these findings, we develop a theoretical model that incorporates LLM technology, information-processing capacity constraints, underreaction, and limits to arbitrage.
